comparison.objective: Recover stranded slot cars while avoiding a moving protected car; candidate sets a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed insertion into a moving track with collision avoidance versus stationary two-tool adjustment and verification.
comparison.success_condition: Cars released, lane-engaged, and independently travelling versus locked angle and repeatable gripper motion.
comparison.reason: The dynamic obstacle and track-engagement ability is unrelated to locknut adjustment.
